subject: [PATCH v4 07/13] mm/collapse: name the per-table scan reset for what it resets

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch renames the function collapse_control_init_scan() to collapse_scan_reset(), which more accurately reflects its purpose of resetting accumulated data for a scan, including node load, allocation nodemask, and eligible-PTE bitmap. This change is part of a larger effort to improve the naming conventions in the mm/collapse code and prepare it for further refactoring. The patch does not introduce any functional changes.
